title: Every DCLab model call goes to OpenRouter Qwen, the lead agent included; Anthropic and OpenAI kept
request: The owner moved DCLab's model to OpenRouter qwen/qwen3.8-flash: make sure the lead agent and every model call use it, without deleting the other providers.
plan: Switch the provider in .env, keeping the Anthropic line commented and every key.
Remove model names written in code that cross providers.
Test every purpose under both providers.

decisions.decision: Model names in code are the Anthropic fallbacks only
decisions.why: on OpenRouter every seat reads its tier's model, so a Qwen name never reaches Anthropic's endpoint nor a Claude name OpenRouter, and switching back is one line
the students' exam wrote qwen into its result whatever ran; the comparison with Claude needs the true model

change: models/settings.py served_model; agents/case_agent.py route model; conversation_exam served_models; journeys cheap seats; llm_review default_model and cli; committee and students_exam served model; twin/claude.py and twin/__main__.py follow the provider; tests/test_provider_switch.py; .env (not in git).

findings.defect: The switch was not live: .env still selected Anthropic, so the lead agent ran on Claude Sonnet
findings.scenario: after commit 7d921e40 every tier resolved to claude-sonnet-5-5
findings.fix: DCLAB_LLM_PROVIDER=openrouter in .env, the Anthropic line kept commented

findings.defect: Qwen model names written in code were sent to Anthropic's endpoint
findings.scenario: on Anthropic the route check, the exam's person and judge, the journeys' cheap seats and the reviewer named qwen/qwen3.8-flash
findings.cause: hard-coded names replaced the Claude ones instead of following the tier
findings.fix: each seat reads its tier's model on OpenRouter and keeps the Claude fallback on Anthropic

findings.defect: The twin lane ignored the provider setting
findings.scenario: provider anthropic with the OpenRouter key kept: the twin still sent Qwen to OpenRouter; without that key a Qwen name went to Anthropic
findings.cause: transport chose OpenRouter whenever its key was present, and the model name defaulted to Qwen
findings.fix: the twin follows DCLAB_LLM_PROVIDER for transport, key and model

outcome: Every purpose in settings.PURPOSES, the lead agent's three included, resolves to OpenRouter qwen/qwen3.8-flash; with the Anthropic line restored, every one resolves to Claude again.
lessons: A provider switch is not done until every name written in code follows it: check under both providers.
risks: The reasoning capture labels and training rules for Qwen are other steps of the same plan.
